snippet.title: Mexican Ninja - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Are you ready to unleash chaos in Nuevo Tokyo?

Mexican Ninja is a fast-paced roguelike packed with action, style, and chaotic combat in a retro 2.5D world.

Slice through enemies, master your abilities, and fight your way through a bizarre fusion of cultures and power.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3764970/Mexican_Ninja/

🔥 About the Game

⚔️ High-Speed Combat
• Fast and dynamic battles with precise movement
• Timing and positioning are key to survival

🌆 A Wild Setting
• Explore Nuevo Tokyo, a fusion of Mexican and Japanese culture
• A chaotic world ruled by crime and power

🌀 Roguelike Progression
• Experiment with upgrades and builds
• Each run offers new combinations and challenges

🧠 Skills and Abilities
• Unlock powerful ninja techniques
• Use unique jutsus and combat styles

👕 Customization
• Discover hidden outfits and cosmetics
• Shape your ninja’s identity and playstyle

🎮 Arcade Energy
• Easy to pick up, hard to master
• Designed for intense and rewarding gameplay

⚠️ Content Warning
This game contains stylized violence, strong language, crude humor, and mature themes such as crime and urban chaos. All content is presented in a non-realistic and exaggerated way.
